question: What current CoL XR nomenclature matches can be proposed for the 35 binomial taxa in the historical Bugang River table, without changing the source names or treating taxonomy as field re-identification?

authority.name: Catalogue of Life eXtended Release via GBIF Species Matching API v2

scope: Automated nomenclatural crosswalk only. Each scientificName is the article source string. The API returns a current CoL XR name usage proposal; it does not verify the 2013-2014 specimen identification, station association, distribution, abundance, habitat, ecological class, present-day occurrence, diet or fishing access.
interpretation: All 35 binomial source strings received an exact CoL XR name match in this batch, but eight matched name usages are marked SYNONYM and return a different acceptedUsage; preserve the article spelling in provenance and show accepted names only as review proposals.

The API currently classifies Zenarchopterus dispar under Zenarchopteridae while the article prints Hemiramphidae. This is a family-level taxonomic conflict for independent fish-taxonomy review, not proof that the source specimen was misidentified.
The source table has three genus-only labels (Eleotris, Glossogobius, Awaous); they were not queried or expanded to species.
No GBIF usage key is converted to a legacy numeric ID; keys remain opaque and scoped to the explicit checklistKey and captured index.

disposition.reason: Automatic exact-name matching supplies nomenclature proposals only. The family conflict and source identification remain for human review; no historical claim was projected.

nextAction: Review the eight synonym proposals and the Zenarchopteridae/Hemiramphidae conflict against current authoritative fish taxonomy, preserving the article spelling. After taxonomic review, assess whether a dated historical source assertion can be admitted with its four named reach codes and the original CC Attribution credit.

sources.supports: Official GBIF Species API v2 documentation: POST batch matching accepts up to 1000 independent name queries and returns results in input order.
GBIF documentation on matching against specific checklists and using the explicit CoL XR checklistKey.
Captured match-index metadata and evidence that the selected checklist matching index did not change during this batch.
